title: DM ONLY - Spore-Scar System
content:
Daterra Knows:


Background Info

  • You melded spores with something enhanced by Faerzress in the Underdark.
  • Your spores have a demonic infection.
  • Every time PCs have gotten scars (from getting KO'd) your spores infected the wounds.
  • But your druidic magic is stabilizing everyone as long as they stay close to you.
  • Skabatha gave you a way to use hag magic to harness these demonic spores into useful abilities.

Spellcasting Focus 

  • The Cicada Vial itself is a spellcasting focus. 
  • This means you can hold it in one hand while casting spells, and it counts as Material Components needed for spells. (remember this does not count for Material Components with gold values)
  • Flavor-wise, you temporarily uncork the Vial while casting, letting the spores out to help cast your spell.

How to Gain More Envelopes of Cards 

  • During a Long Rest, you spend 2 hours focusing on another PC in the Party.
  • You hold up the Cicada Vial and it wiggles in there and the spores it gives off whisper creepy little mutterings only you can hear, telling you its ideas for new deals you can make with someone, the rules of the deals, and the abilities they give. (Secretly this is Skab whispering and making these things for Daterra.)

How to Make a Deal and Give Someone a Card

  • During a Long Rest, you spend 2 hours focusing on the Cicada Vial as it whispers a voice only you can hear.
  • If you’re giving yourself a card, you’re making the deal with the creepy voices coming from the Cicada in the Vial.
  • Keep everything secret from other players! Don’t show them cards! Roleplay it out, describing the ability in-character as if making the deal with the other player.
  • PC must have an un-assigned Scar and meet the prerequisites on the card.
  • You focus your spores and weave your druidic magic to harness the Demon/Rift powers infused in their scars (secretly Zugg). The PC then inhales spores from the Vial and permanently gains the new ability.

How People Use Their Card

  • When you or other PCs want to use an ability they gained from a deal card, you must be holding the Cicada Vial like a spell focus.
  • You pop the cork momentarily, letting spores out to mingle with infected spores from you or the other PCs. 
  • As a Free Action, you must always spend 1 of your Hit Dice. Roll your HD. Rolling a 1 is bad.
  • Follow the rules on the card.
  • FYI, normally HD are used to regain health on Short Rests, and you regain half of your HD rounded down after Long Rests.
  • Your HD roll cannot be rerolled by Inspiration or anything else.

Must Use Every Day

  • You must use the Spore-Scar System at least once per day. 
  • This includes either Gaining an Envelope, Making a Deal, or anyone Using a Card ability.
  • If you end the day without doing any of those things, you take a Level of Exhaustion which only goes away once you use the System again.


DM: Daterra’s Original Envelope 


Daterra, Dealer of Fates

Prerequisites: Daterra only

Daterra rolls HD. Rolling a 1 may make you seem more hag-like.

You can broker magical deals with NPCs. Work with the DM for approval each time. Deals must follow Fey 3 Rules of Conduct. Both parties must exchange something of value (max 1000gp or equivalent, DM has item and spell prices for estimating the worth of something).

Asking an NPC about making a deal likely gives you info about what they desire most.

Using this ability may cause permanent physical changes.


DM ONLY:

Feywild 3 Rules of Conduct
  1. Rule of Hospitality. When a friend, an enemy, or a stranger enters your home, you are expected to be gracious and accommodating to them until such time as they prove, by their words or actions, undeserving of such hospitality.
  1. Rule of Ownership. You must not steal from a friend, an enemy, or a stranger. To take something that doesn't belong to you without the rightful owner's permission is a crime and an unforgivable breach of etiquette. A common loophole is to simply swap something with them, or give a gift before taking something through reciprocation.
  1. Rule of Reciprocity. When a friend, an enemy, or a stranger offers you a gift, you are obliged to accept it and offer something of comparable value (be it a gift or a service) in return. Such reciprocation need not happen immediately.
HD Roll 1 Effect: The NPC believes Daterra is one of the actual hags. They react accordingly (likely hostile, fearful, or subservient depending on personality). This misidentification persists and spreads through rumor. Also Hag Transformation: Each time a 1 is rolled causes Daterra's scar to spread with corrupted, blighted flesh. Her hands gradually transform into crow's feet with black talons. Black feathers begin sprouting from her skin. Track uses - at DM's discretion, repeated use moves her closer to permanent transformation into an actual hag.

Daterra, the Mycologist 

Prerequisites: Daterra only

Daterra rolls HD. Rolling a 1, you are drawn toward a certain location and must walk continuously toward it for the duration.

For a number of hours equal to the HD roll, your success rate of finding and identifying special mushrooms is greatly increased. You have a higher chance of knowing if a mushroom is addictive, expensive, or has other notable properties, but it's always still a gamble to consume them.

Using this ability causes gradual permanent physical changes.

DM ONLY:

HD Roll 1 Effect: Daterra feels an overwhelming urge to walk toward Zuggtmoy or the nearest portal to reach her. She must use her full movement each turn walking toward this destination, even into danger, for the duration (hours equal to the HD roll). This compulsion cannot be resisted or dispelled. If physically restrained or prevented from moving, she takes damage at the start of each of her turns equal to her spore reaction ability damage as her spores go haywire and damage her from within. This damage cannot be prevented or reduced by any means.
 Each Time Activated: Each use causes Daterra's scar to spread with permanent fungal growth in the style of The Last of Us - mushroom caps, cordyceps-like tendrils, and visible mycelia sprouting from that area of her body.
 Make more Special Mushrooms: If Daterra chooses this ability card, put the effort into making many more mushrooms to find.

Daterra, the Vibe

Prerequisites: Daterra only

Daterra rolls HD. The roll determines how much of a good or bad vibe you put out around you.

As an Action, your spores spread outward, giving you a general sense of the surrounding area and any creatures in it. You learn general attitudes of creatures, plants, and the area around you - hostile, friendly, fearful, etc. The DM hints at anything dangerous or lurking nearby. Can be combined with Insight or another skill check for more specific information.

Then, choose a vibe, feeling, or trippy effect you want to project. Your HD roll determines effectiveness. You affect a number of creatures/plants equal to the roll. The highest and lowest die rolls explode (reroll and add total). You become a walking psychedelic drug for others.

Using this ability causes gradual permanent physical changes.

DM ONLY:

HD Roll Mechanics:
  • Duration: Number of hours or minutes equal to the HD roll, whichever makes more sense.
  • Highest die result explodes (reroll and add). Total is how many targets she can affect, and the higher the number the more potent the affect or vibe.
  • Roll of 1 explodes negatively: Subtract instead of add. Example: 1, then 4 = -4 total. 1, then max die = keep rolling negative.
  • Negative total = that many creatures/plants become hostile and receive a bad trip/vibe, and the higher the number the more potent the affect or vibe.
HD Roll 1 Effect: Beyond making nearby creatures hostile, negative totals also draw Zuggtmoy's attention and influence. The more negative the total, the stronger the pull:
  • Demons may be drawn to her location
  • She may feel compelled to walk toward Zuggtmoy/portals
  • Zuggtmoy can see through affected creatures' eyes
  • The area becomes tainted with demonic spores
Each Time Activated: The scar spreads as speckled, multicolored patterns across her skin, growing larger with each activation. The speckles' colors shift to match Daterra's current emotions and vibe - angry reds, calm blues, fearful purples, etc. This creates a permanent tie between her emotional state and her physical appearance.

____ , the Voice Without Words

Prerequisites: None

Daterra rolls HD. Rolling a 1, plants turn against you.

For a number of minutes equal to the HD roll, you share “rapport spores” with all other willing Spore-Scarred in the area near Daterra. Share emotions and non-word communications like “spidey sense” or silent scouting ideas. Share emotional states through the network (courage, fear, determination).

You can bolster others and give the Help action at a distance. Use your Action, Bonus Action, or Reaction to alert others with “spidey sense”, coordinate silently, come up with your own uses.

This also creates a connection with all plant life in the area around you as you move. Plants know the general feelings you're giving and may react accordingly.

Using this ability causes gradual permanent physical changes.

DM ONLY:

HD Roll 1 Effect: All plant life in the area around you for the duration becomes hostile. They recognize this ability as demonic in origin and react with aggression - vines lash out, roots trip and grab, thorns attack, trees drop branches, etc. Use appropriate plant-based attacks or environmental hazards.
 Each Time Activated: The rapport extends to all plants, not just the party. Plants sense the emotional broadcast and respond:
  • Positive emotions (courage, joy, peace): Plants may provide cover, move aside, or become easier to navigate
  • Negative emotions (fear, anger, hostility): Plants may obstruct, attack, or create difficult terrain
  • This secretly connects the Party and plants to Zuggtmoy/myconid plot threads - she can sense through plants touched by these spores
Also Each Time Activated: The scar spreads with permanent fungal growth in the style of The Last of Us - mushroom caps, cordyceps-like tendrils, and visible mycelia sprouting from that area of the body. This growth is always active and visible.


DM: Kronk Envelope 


Kronk, Herald of the Gentle Path

Prerequisites: Kronk only

Daterra rolls HD. Rolling a certain secret number may mislead you.

As an Action, for a number of minutes equal to the HD roll, you gain hints from the Ethereal Plane showing paths of least resistance in the surrounding area. You sense paths with fewer creatures or obstructions, hidden dangers or magics are highlighted, and you receive foresight of what might happen if certain choices are made. The DM provides guidance on potential outcomes based on what you say the Party might choose to do next.

When activated, your scar glows with ghostly, ethereal fog like headlights - highly visible to anyone nearby.

Using this ability causes gradual permanent physical changes.

DM ONLY:

On Kronk’s path to learn to not be savage orc like his family was, Shuushar opened his mind to ‘pacifish’ methods and the ethereal realm.
 HD Roll Secret Number: DM choose a random die number. Don't reveal this to players. If Daterra's HD roll matches this number, the hints from the Ethereal Plane are misleading and designed to endanger the Party. Give plausible-sounding advice that leads them into danger. Also, Kronk takes one step closer to permanently becoming ethereal/a ghost - one body part at a time begins phasing between planes (hand, foot, arm, etc.). Track which parts have been affected.
 On Normal HD Roll: Give genuine helpful information. Reveal hidden threats, suggest safer routes, warn of consequences. Be generous with plot hints that steer them toward good outcomes.
 Each Time Activated: After the glowing effect fades, the scar settles into a permanent ghostly white color that spreads larger across his flesh with each activation. The white glow is always visible, even when the ability isn't active. Track this permanent change.

____ , the Window Between Worlds 

Prerequisites: None

Daterra rolls HD. Rolling a 1, something gazes back.

As an Action, for a number of minutes equal to the HD roll, you can use your wounds as literal windows. You can physically look through your scar and see out another willing Spore-Scarred's, no matter the distance between them. Must physically look through the scar or use a mirror.

Both the viewer and the target take unavoidable damage equal to Daterra's HD roll as both scars split open and bleed.

Using this ability causes gradual permanent physical changes.

DM ONLY:

HD Roll 1 Effect: Something looks back through the window at the viewer. Options:
  • A demon or entity on another plane notices the connection and makes eye contact
  • Ollie or something from his timeline/situation peers back through
  • A creature near a rift or faerzress senses the connection and investigates
  • The viewer catches a glimpse of something that wasn't supposed to be seen
Demon Lord Interference: When rifts are opened like this, demon lords (like Demogorgon) can latch onto the connection. They might:
  • Make brief visual or telepathic contact
  • See through the window themselves, observing both parties
  • Reroute what's visible through the window to show somewhere else
  • Send visions, objects, or even creatures through
Ollie Time Plot Hooks: This ability deals with rifts through space/time. Give hints about Ollie's/Horcux’s situations when appropriate. There's a chance each use that they see something peering back at them through the rift - use this to seed plot threads and foreshadowing.
 Each Time Activated: The scar stays permanently open slightly - never fully closing again. Glimpses of other planes are visible through the gap: slivers of light, darkness, void, celestial radiance, abyssal corruption, etc. The opening grows larger with each activation, eventually becoming an obvious supernatural wound that constantly shows otherworldly vistas.

____ , Voidhand

Prerequisites: Perry or Kronk only

Daterra rolls HD. Rolling a 1, something reaches back.

Action, Bonus, or Reaction. Reach through your open scar and out of another ally's scar to use your hand or weapon - swing, grab, etc. You must use one hand to hold your scar open and your other hand to reach through.

Both you and your ally take unavoidable damage equal to Daterra's HD roll as your scar wounds split open and bleed.

Using this ability causes gradual permanent physical changes.

DM ONLY:

HD Roll 1 Effect: Something else reaches through at them! Options:
  • A demon or abyssal creature reaches through and attacks (use appropriate CR)
  • The creature grabs them and attempts to pull them through to a rift/plot location
  • A demon partially emerges through the scar into their location
  • They catch a glimpse of what's on the other side before something notices them
Demon Lord Interference: When rifts are opened like this, demon lords (like Demogorgon) can latch onto the connection. They might:
  • Make brief visual or telepathic contact
  • Reroute the rift to a different location than intended
  • Send minions or objects through the rift
  • Mark the users for future tracking
Ollie Time Plot Hooks: This ability deals with rifts through space/time. Give hints about Ollie's/Horcux’s situations when appropriate. There's a chance each use that they see something peering back at them through the rift - use this to seed plot threads and foreshadowing.
 Each Time Activated: Duration up to a number of rounds equal to the HD roll. The scar opens as a swirling black void. When it closes, a section of flesh is left marred with crisscrossing stitch lines and cuts. The opening stretches in a longer line each time - eventually the scar flaps open a huge portion of the body, making it increasingly grotesque and difficult to conceal.

____ , the Reflectionist

Prerequisites: None

Daterra rolls HD. Same consequences as the echoed ability.

When another person activates a scar ability, you can "echo" it and use the same effects using the same rules and HD roll. You must choose to echo before anything is rolled, chosen, or results are shown.

Using this ability causes gradual permanent physical changes.

DM ONLY:

Echo Mechanics: Action, Bonus, Reaction, or Free depends on what is being echoed. This ability must be declared before any rolls, choices, or outcomes. Once echoed, both users experience identical mechanical effects - same HD roll result, same duration, same consequences. If the original user rolls a 1, so does the echo user. Both take damage if applicable, both gain benefits if applicable. They share the same fate for that activation.  The echo user doesn't need to meet the prerequisites of the original ability (like "Daterra only" or "requires knowing damage type").
 Each Time Activated: The scar permanently changes appearance. Either:
  • Takes on the aesthetic of the echoed ability (fungal growth if echoing Mycologist, runes if echoing Name Reader, etc.)
  • OR gains a shiny mirrored metallic chrome coating
Choose whichever makes more thematic sense. Over time, the scar becomes a patchwork of different aesthetics from all the abilities echoed, or becomes increasingly chrome-covered.

____ , the Infected 

Prerequisites: None

Daterra rolls HD. Rolling a 1, the infection spreads uncontrollably.

You must first inflict a significant wound on another creature within the radius of Daterra's spore effect. Then as a free action, activate this ability and they become infected with spores. They are considered a Spore-Scarred and any other scar abilities now work with them.

They now have consequences for not being near enough to Daterra’s spores.

Using this ability causes gradual permanent physical changes.

DM ONLY:

HD Roll 1 Effect: The infection spores go out of control and infect any number of unintended creatures or plants nearby (DM's choice). This can include allies, enemies, innocent bystanders, all plant life in the area, etc. Use this to bring more Zuggtmoy plot elements - infected creatures become unknowing agents of her influence.
 Secret Zuggtmoy Influence: Every creature infected with these spores becomes connected to Zuggtmoy's fungal network. She can:
  • Sense their location and emotional state
  • Influence their dreams or thoughts subtly
  • Track the party's movements through infected NPCs
  • Speak through infected creatures 
  • Use them as anchors to spread her influence to new areas
Stability Requirement: Newly infected must stay within a certain distance of Daterra or they begin experiencing the same rifting/instability that Ollie suffers. They disintegrate, have visions, feel pulled toward rifts, etc. This keeps them tethered to Daterra and dependent on her presence.
 Each Time Activated: The scar spreads with permanent fungal growth in the style of The Last of Us - mushroom caps, cordyceps-like tendrils, and visible mycelia sprouting from that area of the body. This growth is always active and visible.


DM: Perry Envelope 


Perry, Warden of Memories

Prerequisites: Perry only

Daterra rolls HD. Rolling a 1, you lose part of yourself.

When first gaining this card, choose another Spore-Scarred to be connected with. You experience their pain and memories whenever they activate their scar ability. 

As an Action, you can fill a marble with all the memories of any one Spore-Scarred if you speak their true name. You can delve into stored memories anytime. Each marble can only be filled once.

The DM can provide lore, backstory, secrets, visions, or other information by request.

Using this ability causes gradual permanent physical changes.

DM ONLY:

HD Roll 1 Effect: Perry loses one of his filled marbles permanently. The marble shatters, cracks, or simply vanishes - and with it, a piece of Perry's own mind and memories are permanently erased. He doesn't remember what he lost, but feels the absence. Track which marbles/memories are lost. If he loses too many, he may begin losing parts of his own identity and personality.
 Memory Access: Duration, number of minutes equal to the HD roll. When Perry delves into a marble or experiences another Spore-Scarred activation, provide rich sensory detail. Give genuine secrets, plot hooks, backstory, and emotional weight. This is a powerful information-gathering tool - use it to reward clever use and deepen the story.
 Each Time Activated: Perry's scar spreads to include a visual representation or "spin" on the scar of whoever he's connecting with. His body may literally take on aspects of that person's flesh - their skin coloring, texture, scars, or other physical traits appear on Perry's body as a permanent patchwork. He's slowly becoming a living amalgamation of everyone he's connected with.

Perry, (creature type) Seeker

Prerequisites: Perry only. Requires knowing exactly what creature caused the scar.

Daterra rolls HD. Rolling a 1, they hunt you instead.

As an Action, ror a number of hours equal to the HD roll, you sense when similar creatures are nearby within 120ft and know their exact location as if they glow. You also gain bits of knowledge, lore, and plot about that exact creature type for the duration.

You are blind to all other creature types for the duration.

When activated, your scar explodes with blinding hot radiant light like the sun for a moment (counts as sunlight).

Using this ability causes gradual permanent physical changes.

DM ONLY:

HD Roll 1 Effect: This all happens in secret in background. Instead of Perry sensing them, those creatures are drawn to Perry and see him glowing in the same way. They hunt him as prized big game, or perceive him as an antichrist figure bound to doom their race, or he becomes prophetically significant in their cultural lore/religion. They will pursue him relentlessly. Additionally, Perry becomes permanently blind to that creature type until Greater Restoration or higher magic - they are completely invisible and undetectable to him.
 Normal HD Rolls: Provide genuinely useful lore - weaknesses, habits, cultural information, plot connections, historical context. Make this feel like a meaningful trade-off for the tunnel vision.
 Each Time Activated: After the blinding radiant burst fades, the scar settles into a permanent whitish coloring that spreads across Perry's skin and fur, growing larger with each activation. The white patches are always visible.

____ , Fiendflesh

Prerequisites: Perry or Kronk only. Requires knowing exactly what damage type caused scar.

Daterra rolls HD. Rolling a 1, you will have permanent changes.

Action or Bonus. For a number of minutes equal to the HD roll, you gain resistance to the damage type that caused your scar. Your scar opens into rifts, pouring forth colors and textures befitting the damage type - mouths, eyes, claws, fangs, and flesh transformed into something otherworldly.

You become vulnerable to another damage type of your choice for the duration.

DM ONLY:

HD Roll 1 Effect: The vulnerability and demonic appearance become permanent, even after the resistance and other effects end. Your body tears and disintegrates at the scar, pulling in actual demon flesh from the rift. You are now literally part demon. Nothing short of a Wish spell can reverse this transformation.
 Appearance details: Tailor the demonic flesh to match the damage type (fire = charred scales and embers, necrotic = rotting with void-black veins, etc.).

____ , Collector of Names

Prerequisites: None

Daterra rolls HD. Rolling a 1, your own name and thoughts are revealed.

Free action. You get a feeling hinting at a person or creature's true name. Sometimes just a single letter. Sometimes all letters but jumbled. The clarity varies.

Using this ability causes gradual permanent physical changes.

DM ONLY:

HD Roll 1 Effect: The ability backfires catastrophically. Your own true name is projected telepathically to every creature within 60 feet, and they also receive all effects of Detect Thoughts on you continuously. This projection is permanent and indefinite - all creatures near you can always sense your true name and read your thoughts. Only Greater Restoration or higher magic can end this effect.
 Each Time Activated: The scar painfully carves outward, forming rune-like letters and symbols on your flesh containing fragments of the name information you received. These burn themselves into your skin as permanent scarring, creating an ever-growing map of names across your body.
 Name Information: Give cryptic hints. Roll secretly to determine clarity: 1-5 = single letter, 6-12 = several letters, 13-17 = all letters jumbled, 18-20 = mostly correct with 1-2 letters wrong. Adjust difficulty as needed.

____ , the Bite-Marked

Prerequisites: None

Daterra rolls HD. Rolling a 1, the mouth takes its price.

As an Action, use both free hands to peel open your scar into a pocket dimension. Works just like a Bag of Holding that only opens when activated. 

You take unavoidable damage equal to the HD roll as you split open your own skin.

The opening stays open for a number of rounds equal to the HD roll. It looks like a black void, with edges lined with teeth like a mimic's mouth.

Using this ability causes gradual permanent physical changes.

DM ONLY:

HD Roll 1 Effect: The teeth bite off one of your fingers and keep it inside the bag, never letting you retrieve it. The finger is gone permanently (except by Regenerate spell or higher magic). Track which fingers are lost - this affects what the character can do:
  • Thumb: Disadvantage on checks requiring fine manipulation with that hand
  • Multiple fingers: May be unable to wield two-handed weapons or cast spells with somatic components properly
  • All fingers on one hand: Hand is effectively useless
Bag of Holding Rules: Functions as standard Bag of Holding:
  • Holds up to 500 lbs, not exceeding 64 cubic feet
  • Weighs 15 lbs regardless of contents
  • Retrieving an item requires an action
  • If overloaded, pierced, or torn, it ruptures and is destroyed (translates to severe injury to user)
  • Placing it inside another extradimensional space causes both to be destroyed and opens a gate to the Astral Plane (extremely dangerous for the user)
Each Time Activated: After closing, the opening settles into a closed mouth with zipper-like teeth permanently visible on the skin. The mouth spreads larger across the body with each activation, eventually covering a significant portion of the torso or limb.

DM: Jibjib Envelope 


Jibjib, Scholar of the Darkened Depths

Prerequisites: Jibjib only

Daterra rolls HD. Rolling a 1, the madness takes hold.

As an Action, your scar opens a direct link to Dagon through a Rift. Hidden knowledge flows into your Tome as strange symbols and vague cryptic words. The knowledge appears as answers to whatever you're currently most focused on - just a few words, never full sentences, or inky drawings and symbols.

When activated, wet Cthulhu-like tentacles dripping with ink squeeze out of your opened scar.

Using this ability causes gradual permanent physical changes.

DM ONLY:

HD Roll 1 Effect: Jibjib gains Indefinite Madness from exposure to cosmic horror. Roll on Indefinite Madness table or choose something thematically appropriate - paranoia about being watched from the deep, compulsion to draw eldritch symbols, belief that water is alive and speaking to him, etc. This madness is permanent until Greater Restoration or similar magic.
 Knowledge from Dagon: Duration, number of minutes equal to the HD roll. Keep answers cryptic and open to interpretation. A few words, never sentences. Inky drawings that might show symbols, creatures, locations, or abstract concepts. The knowledge is real and useful but requires interpretation. Dagon's perspective is alien and oceanic - answers might reference depths, drowning, tides, pressure, or transformation.
 Each Time Activated: After the tentacles retreat, the scar settles into a permanent inky black color. Thin tentacle-like patterns spread larger across the skin with each activation, creating a web of dark lines that look like they're writhing just beneath the surface.

Jibjib, the Frog Whisperer

Prerequisites: Jibjib only

Daterra rolls HD. Rolling a 1, the frog meets a dark fate.

As an Action, for a number of minutes equal to the HD roll, you can cast Speak with Animals on frogs only, telepathically - no one else hears the conversation. The voice responding through the frog is an unknown fellow follower of Dagon who has a high chance of knowing about conspiracies revolving around a specific person, creature, place, or topic you're currently focused on. The conversation is very brief.

When activated, your scar leaks swamp water and flies squeeze out to help coax a frog near.

There is also always a slight chance the voice is lying/misleading you.

Using this ability causes gradual permanent physical changes.

DM ONLY:

HD Roll 1 Effect: The frog implodes and dies, collapsing into a tiny black hole rift that opens from Jibjib's scar, sucking the frog into the void. Also use this to lead them toward any existing demon plot - the voice might give a cryptic warning or direction before the connection is severed violently.
 Conspiracy Information: When it's a real Dagon follower, provide actual useful conspiracy theories that connect to real plot elements - who's secretly working for whom, hidden agendas, dangerous secrets. Make it feel like an underground information network.
 Each Time Activated: There's a small secret chance that the voice is actually coming from a minor demon (not a Dagon follower) who is bent on misleading Jibjib with false conspiracies and lies. DM choose a secret number, and if HD rolls it this happens. If it's the demon, Jibjib gets a slight hint something feels off (roll secretly Insight vs Deception). Don't reveal outright that it's lying unless she succeeds.   
 Also each time: After the swamp water and flies dissipate, your scar settles into swampy coloration - murky greens, browns, and stagnant water hues - that spreads larger across the flesh with each activation.

____ , the Compass of Rot

Prerequisites: None

Daterra rolls HD. No consequences for rolling a 1.

As a free action, for a number of hours equal to the HD roll, choose one guidance to feel:

  1. Pointed toward and know how far from "Her" or "the Lady"
  2. Pointed toward and know how long before the "Ceremony"
  3. Pointed toward the greatest source of rot and decay around

You don't know what these things mean - you just get feelings gently pulling you in a direction.

You also heal HP equal to the HD roll.

Using this ability causes gradual permanent physical changes.

DM ONLY:

Secret Meaning: All options refer to Zuggtmoy:
  1. "Her" / "the Lady" = Zuggtmoy's current location
  1. "the Ceremony" = Neverlight Grove wedding
  1. Greatest rot/decay = Often leads toward Zuggtmoy's influence or myconid colonies under her control, but could be Hag things, swamps, undead, etc.
Zugg on Different Plane: If Zuggtmoy is on a different plane, the compass feeling spins or feels disoriented. The user can roll their choice of Intelligence skills to interpret the sensation. Give answers based on the check:
  • Low roll: Just feels confused or broken
  • Medium roll: Senses it's not on this plane
  • High roll: Can identify which plane or general direction to a portal
No Downside on 1: This ability specifically has no negative effect for rolling a 1. It's meant to draw them toward Zuggtmoy plot willingly through seeming helpfulness (healing + guidance).
 Each Time Activated: The scar spreads with permanent fungal growth in the style of The Last of Us - mushroom caps, cordyceps-like tendrils, and visible mycelia sprouting from that area of the body. This growth is always active and visible.

____ , the Resonant 

Prerequisites: None

Daterra rolls HD. Rolling a 1, your senses are cut off and other creatures sense you.

As an Action, for a number of minutes equal to the HD roll, sense your choice of the following from any chosen Spore-Scarred and/or any creature or NPC ever cut open near the Party's spores: 1. their health, 2. their location, or 3. share non-sight sensory information (smell, taste, hearing, touch). Works at any distance or plane, through the fungal network your scars all share.

All willing sharers have disadvantage on sight-based Perception checks for the duration.

When activated, your scar opens into a vacuumous black hole void sucking at the air around you.

Using this ability causes gradual permanent physical changes.

DM ONLY:

HD Roll 1 Effect: Instead of connecting to others, you are severed from your own senses. You become Blinded, Deafened, and Muted for 1 hour. Additionally, any creatures near rifts or faerzress can sense you instead - they know your location, emotional state, and surface thoughts. Use this to bring plot to the party - demons, Zuggtmoy's agents, or other entities tracking them through planar connections become aware of their location and condition.
 Fungal Network: This works through the mycelial/spore network Daterra has created. Any creature that's been significantly wounded near the party's spores is connected to this network permanently. Keep a list of major NPCs/creatures this applies to. The connection transcends planes and distance.
 Sensory Sharing Details:
  • Health: Know exact HP, conditions, injuries, poison/disease status
  • Location: General sense of where they are (region, plane, environment type)
  • Non-sight senses: Smell what they smell, taste what they taste, hear what they hear, feel what they touch
Each Time Activated: When not active, the scar settles into a permanent blackened area like a solid filled-in tattoo section - pure matte black void coloration - that spreads larger across the body with each activation.

____ , the Imprinted 

Prerequisites: Requires knowing what creature originally caused scar.

Daterra rolls HD. Rolling a 1, you lose more of yourself.

The creature that caused your scar has imprinted on you, making you partially that creature or species. As a free action, for a number of hours equal to the HD roll, you gain insider knowledge about that species, advantage on relevant rolls, and gain some of its memories, emotions, and personality traits.

DM ONLY:

HD Roll 1 Effect: You take one step closer to becoming that species permanently and losing your original self. Secretly track transformation progress - choose an appropriate number of steps (suggest 3-5 depending on creature power level and story impact).
 When fully transformed: The PC becomes an NPC. Their original soul is claimed by Zuggtmoy or another appropriate demon lord. Their body is now inhabited by the soul of a creature of the imprinted type. The player must create a new character.
 Transformation Stages: Track physical and mental changes:
  • Stage 1: Minor physical traits (eye color, skin texture, small features)
  • Stage 2: Significant physical changes (limbs, body structure) and personality shifts
  • Stage 3: Major transformation (mostly creature, barely humanoid) and memory confusion
  • Final: Complete transformation, soul replacement
Plot Integration: Always weave plot involving that species into this ability. Grant memories that reveal:
  • Locations of that species' lairs or territories
  • Secrets about their culture or hierarchy
  • Connections to current plot threads
  • Information about powerful individuals of that species
  • Motivations or plans relevant to the campaign
Each Time Activated: The scar area splits open to reveal the aesthetics of that creature - scales, fur, feathers, chitin, demonic flesh, etc. Afterward, it reverts to normal scar.

Prerequisites: Sig only

Daterra rolls HD. Rolling a 1, spirits pull you a step closer to death.

As an Action, for a number of minutes equal to the HD roll, you can see echoes of any creatures or people that have died in the current area. You know when and how they died and gain important plot, lore, and secrets from the vision.

When activated, your scar oozes with black blood that drips to the ground and spreads, revealing black scenery visions.

Using this ability causes gradual permanent physical changes.

DM ONLY:

HD Roll 1 Effect: Spirits are drawn to Sig and latch onto him, trying to pull him into the afterlife with them - where he belongs before he was brought back from death. He permanently loses one of his 3 death saves. This can only be restored by a Wish spell. If he loses all 3 death saves through repeated use, the next time he would make a death save, he automatically dies and cannot be resurrected by any means short of divine intervention.
 Vision Information: Show echoes of deaths that occurred in the area - battles, murders, natural deaths, sacrifices. Provide plot-relevant information through these visions.  Each Time Activated: After the black blood visions fade, the scar spreads larger and transforms into frostbite-like black corrupted flesh. Track how much of his skeleton is exposed - eventually significant portions of his body will be skeletal while he still lives.

Sig, the Faith Leaper

Prerequisites: Sig only

Daterra rolls HD. Rolling a 1, something peers back at you. Rolling multiple 1’s, you don’t teleport in one piece.

Action or Bonus. Teleport 10ft by briefly opening a small Rift through your scar.

You can choose to increase distance (20ft, 30ft, etc.) or bring additional people (1 person, 2 people, etc.), but each upgrade requires Daterra to spend and roll an additional HD - increasing your chances of rolling a 1. 

You must be bleeding or spill your own blood to open the Rift. Your scar must be pried open with your free hands into a glowing crack of planar energy. You are swirled inside out and compressed into your own scar, then reversed and expanded at your destination.

Using this ability causes gradual permanent physical changes.

DM ONLY:

HD Roll 1 Effect: Something peers back through the Rift or interferes with the passage.
 Multiple 1’s Rolled: The Rift closes mid-transit and splices off a limb. Roll randomly or choose narratively:
  • Hand/Arm lost: Can only do one-handed actions. Cannot perform two actions/interactions per turn. Significantly limits combat and exploration options.
  • Foot/Leg lost: Movement speed reduced to 5ft (hopping). Any effect that would slow movement renders them immobile instead.
This is permanent except by Regenerate spell or higher magic.
 Demon Lord Interference: When rifts are opened like this, demon lords (like Demogorgon) can latch onto the connection. They might:
  • Make brief visual or telepathic contact
  • Reroute the rift to a different location than intended
  • Send minions or objects through the rift
  • Mark the users for future tracking
Ollie Time Plot Hooks: This ability deals with rifts through space/time. Give hints about Ollie's/Horcux’s situations when appropriate. There's a chance each use that they see something peering back at them through the rift - use this to seed plot threads and foreshadowing.
 Each Time Activated: After the Rift closes, the scar settles into strange astrological patterning like a tattoo - constellations, planetary alignments, cosmic symbols - that spreads larger across the skin with each activation.
